sources.title: Qwen3.5 | Radxa Docs
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 is a native multimodal large model released by Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Lab in February 2026, using a hybrid architecture (linear attention + MoE) with 397 billion total parameters and 17 billion activated parameters, supporting 201 languages, and performing excellently in reasoning, programming, agent capabilities, and multimodal understanding.
